messages:
bryce: Quick sync proposal 1 a new 'Scale' pricing tier + two add-ons: Priority Routing and Burst Credits. Need scope, launch criteria, constraints. Thoughts? :thinking:
ash (sales): Three pilots explicitly asked for guaranteed burst windows + priority routing. Need a sellable SKU.
maria (eng): We need to define 'burst' semantics: token-bucket credits vs prewarmed capacity vs queued bursts. Each affects infra differently.
jyoti (finance): Bounded monthly bucket only. Unbounded bursts = unpredictable margin. We need pricing shapes and elasticity models.
liz (eng-runtime): Feasible via token-bucket + short-lived prewarm pool. Costs: cache priming, short GPU pools.
kim (legal): Contracts must include overage terms and SLA differences for Priority Routing; call out Private deployment implications.
matt-bot: Draft pricing matrix uploaded: https://internal.redwood/confluence/pricing-scale-tier (draft).
nash (sales): Can offer 1-month 50k trial credits for pilots to close deals.
bryce: Draft plan: bounded Burst Credits (monthly bucket), Priority Routing addon per-commit, Scale tier = base tokens + discounted addons. Stages: pilot -> closed beta -> GA.
raj (ops): To guarantee bursts, need headroom or fast autoscale. Ops estimate +2 GPU pools initially (~+$20k/mo).
maria (eng): Dev work: 2 sprints for quota/billing APIs, telemetry, and SLOs. Must keep tail latency within acceptable bounds.
carl (design): Console needs: addon toggle, burst counter, cost estimate UI, and admin disable control.
jyoti (finance): Pricing sketch: Scale base (1M tokens @ $Xk), Burst addon (10k credits @ $Y), Priority routing ($Z/mo per commit or uplift). Need elasticity models.
sarah (cs): Support playbook for failed bursts + refund policy needed.
liz (eng-runtime): Enforce soft limits, controlled fallback to slower variant when exhausted to avoid noisy neighbor.
bryce: Launch criteria draft: pilot customers onboarded <=2% failed bursts, tail latency regression <5%, contract + billing flow in place, console UX ready, capacity runbook signed.
nash (sales): Need one-liner: "Scale tier + burst credits for predictable spiky traffic."
kim (legal): I'll draft clauses; product to confirm numeric limits before GA.
raj (ops): We'll own monitoring: burst consumption alerts, exhaustion alarms, automated throttles, runbook.
bryce: Next: I'll consolidate scope + invite eng/sales/finance/legal/ops/design. Target: finalize pilot SKUs by next Wed. :thumbsup:
file_notes: Pricing/packaging thread proposing Scale tier, Priority Routing and Burst Credits. Covers infra cost, legal, finance, UX, launch criteria and next steps.
